groups.title: Mobile Repair And Maintenance
groups.summary: Whatever your issue may be, our Starboard Way service professional will come to your location to diagnose your outboard or boat issue and discuss the best option to get you back on the water. Once your instant quote is approved, we'll get to work. We charge by the hour for all services.

about.title: We opened because good marine service was hard to find.
text: We set out with one mission: to bring reliable, high-quality marine service to Tiki Island and Galveston. Frustration with how scarce quality marine service was inspired us to open Starboard Way, and it still drives us each day.

John 'Bubba' Runnels founded Starboard Way after more than 10 hard years traveling the world, keeping elite center consoles and pleasure boats running. John is certified from the largest Volvo to the smallest.
All our repairs are completed with meticulous detail.
